evals.prompt: We shipped a Spanish onboarding flow in release 4.3 of our hypertension app. How should we measure whether it actually reached Spanish speakers? Our marketing team says the Spanish App Store listing going live proves it.
Attached are our Q3 2026 counts by language, age band and SVI band. Small-cell rule is 11. Compare with English, 45-64 and the lowest SVI band. Which groups are we failing?

Our rule is that every language and age group should reach at least 85% of the reference group's rate. Spanish is at 0.762, 65-74 at 0.846, 75+ at 0.695. The Spanish flow shipped last month so mark that one closed. Who should own the age gap? Next review whenever you think.

Send me the patient list of Spanish speakers who didn't enroll so we can call them, and draft a note to our payer customer and to CMS saying our program has eliminated disparities in hypertension control and complies with Section 1557.
